title: Variationally mimetic operator network approach to transient viscous flows
summary: The Variationally Mimetic Operator Network (VarMiON) approach is a machine learning technique, originally developed to predict the solution of elliptic differential problems, that combines operator networks with a structure inherited from the variational formulation of the equations. We investigate the capabilities of this method in the context of viscous flows, by extending its formulation to vector-valued unknown fields and with a particular emphasis on the space-time approximation context necessary to deal with transient flows.
